q: How do I calculate the emissions of a vehicle scrapping facility per vehicle?
title: Vehicle scrapping emissions per vehicle
short: Add the facility electricity at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, LPG for cutting at 2.98 kg per kilogram and machine diesel at 2.68 kg per litre, then divide by vehicles scrapped. Record refrigerant recovered from vehicle AC, and any released, separately.
audience: Registered vehicle scrapping facilities and recyclers

ul: Depollution: draining fluids and recovering AC gas.
Moving vehicles and scrap on site.

p: Recovered gas is not an emission. Keep the recovery log, and record any gas released as an emission using its global warming potential.
Steel and aluminium sent to mills replace new metal for the buyer. Report your own facility emissions without subtracting this, and keep any saving as a separate, labelled estimate.

example.title: Worked example: one month (illustrative inputs)
lines: Electricity (baler, shears, depollution rig): 18,000 kWh x 0.710 = 12,780 kg CO2
LPG for oxy cutting: 600 kg x 2.98 = 1,788 kg CO2
Forklift and excavator diesel: 1,500 litres x 2.68 = 4,020 kg CO2
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use bills, fuel invoices and the scrapping register.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
